htn_kidney.title: Temporal trends and geographic variation in mortality from hypertensive diseases with co-existing aplastic and other anemias in the United States (U.S.) - a CDC WONDER analysis from 1999 to 2023.
htn_kidney.authors: Baig MMA, Amjad A, Usman A
htn_kidney.zhSummary: 该文聚焦高血压肾病，属于临床研究。核心观点：该英文报道关注最新动态：Hypertensive diseases are a leading cause of mortality in the U.S.... 临床提示：该英文报道关注最新动态：Hypertension and anemia are linked in both directions....
htn_kidney.abstract: Hypertensive diseases are a leading cause of mortality in the U.S. Hypertension and anemia are linked in both directions. Hypertensive nephropathy, endothelial injury, and chronic inflammation reduce erythropoietin secretion and suppress erythropoiesis, while anemia lowers oxygen delivery and raises cardiac workload, which worsens hypertensive end-organ damage. National mortality patterns for deaths in which both conditions are recorded remain poorly defined. We analyzed deaths among adults aged ≥25 years in the CDC WONDER Multiple Cause of Death database from 1999 to 2023. portal_hypertension.abstract: Portopulmonary hypertension (POPH) carries a poor prognosis, yet the influence of gender and race on inpatient outcomes is not well defined. Prior registry data suggested that POPH occurred more frequently in Hispanic patients and was associated with higher all-cause mortality. We examined whether gender and race were associated with inpatient outcomes in POPH hospitalizations. We analyzed the 2017-2019 National Inpatient Sample. portal_hypertension.abstract: Fontan-associated liver disease and refractory ascites represent advanced systemic failure in patients with Fontan circulation, with limited therapeutic options. A 38-year-old woman with tricuspid atresia, after a Fontan procedure, developed progressive Fontan-associated liver disease and recurrent refractory ascites. Imaging showed portal hypertension and cirrhosis, and liver biopsy confirmed advanced congestive hepatopathy with stage V fibrosis. She was not a candidate for transplant or further intervention, so a tunneled peritoneal catheter was placed for palliative drainage. Refractory ascites reflects Fontan failure and a worse prognosis. portal_hypertension.abstract: Steatotic liver disease (SLD) is a major contributor to the global burden of chronic liver disease and is linked to liver fibrosis. Emerging evidence implicates activin A in this process, but its role remains unclear due to conflicting findings. This cross-sectional study examines circulating levels of activin A and its endogenous inhibitor follistatin in individuals with metabolic dysfunction and evaluates their associations with clinical indicators of steatosis and fibrosis. Plasma activin A and follistatin were measured with ELISA in 309 participants with type 2 diabetes (T2D) with or without SLD and in 97 participants with SLD-related cirrhosis.
